title: Seagrove Beach "Beachful Easy Feeling" 59 Santa Clara Street
h1: Seagrove Beach "Beachful Easy Feeling" 59 Santa Clara Street
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS- 3-minute walk or less to beach- Santa Clara access is ADA accessible via ramp and has parking, restrooms, and lifeguards during peak season- Private pool**Pool heating available October 1-May 1 for $60 per day** - 2-minute drive to Publix in WaterColor Shopping Center- Short bike ride to Seaside or favorite local restaurants, Cafe 30A, Surfing Deer, and Market Cafe- 2 Refrigerators and 2 dishwashers- 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- 5 adult bikes provided- Parking for 6 vehicles- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout*Please note that the second floor is only accessible via the outdoor stairs. Each floor has its own kitchen.DETAILS: Every day’s a delight at Beachful Easy Feeling! Tucked within Seagrove Beach, this 5-bedroom, 4-bathroom home sleeps up to 14 guests with 2 kitchens and separate living spaces, making it perfect for large families or groups. Cruise over to Seaside for family-friendly fun, or explore the nearby restaurants, including Café 30A, Surfing Deer, and Market Café. Guests will love savoring sun-soaked days by the pool, unwinding on the porches, or strolling to the beach—only 3 minutes away!The private backyard is the gem of the first level. Bask in the Florida sun on the poolside loungers, sip drinks at the shaded table for 4, or slip into the pool for a refreshing swim. When hunger strikes, indulge in juicy burgers and hot dogs cooked on the grill or head inside to the full kitchen. A charming living space features an L-shaped sofa, TV, and a 4-person table. Out the side door, guests will find a beautiful porch outfitted with comfy patio couches. Sleeping accommodations include 1 guest bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom, 1 bunk room with a full-over-full bed, and 1 queen sleeper sofa in the living area. Both levels have a washer and dryer for convenience.On the second floor, accessible via an exterior staircase, polished hardwood floors and a vaulted ceiling complement the natural lighting in the living space, where a wraparound couch, armchair, and TV encourage lounging. At the 6-person wooden table, share flavorful meals prepared in the modern kitchen, featuring quartz countertops, high-end appliances, and a 3-stool breakfast bar. Outside, a back deck with a staircase offers effortless access to the pool deck, or guests can relish the peaceful setting from the patio couch on the side porch. When it’s time for bed, choose between 1 guest bedroom with a queen bed and 1 bunk room with 2 XL twin-over-twin bunks.Enjoy a private retreat in the third-level primary bedroom, featuring a king bed, private bathroom, and balcony.Let worries fade away with a Seagrove Beach escape at Beachful Easy Feeling. Easily explore with parking for 6 vehicles—plus 5 complimentary adult bikes and a 6-passenger low speed vehicle. Santa Clara Beach access is ADA accessible and only a 3-minute walk or 1-minute drive. Book today for a memorable 30A getaway!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 14):FIRST FLOOR- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Hallway Bathroom with Shower and Large, Tiled Walk-in Shower Separate in Hallway- Guest Bedroom: Full-over-Full Bunk Bed, Shared Hallway Bathroom with Tub/Shower Combo- Additional Sleeping Area: Queen Sleeper SofaSECOND FLOOR- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Hallway Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: 2 Twin XL-over-Twin XL Bunk Beds, Shared Hallway Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboTHIRD FLOOR- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Walk-in Shower Only*Guests who are 25 years of age or younger must be accompanied by a responsible parent or guardian in any vacation rental managed by Callista by 360 Blue. We do not rent homes to those 25 years of age or younger who are unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian. Moreover, there must be a ratio of at least (1) parent or guardian over the age of 25 for every four (4) young adults who are 25 years of age or younger.
